verdict.rationale: Dynadot's official MCP server explicitly lists "Check a domain name availability" as a capability an AI agent can call. Dynadot also documents a 120+ action API with a sandbox, but the evidence never names a REST search or availability command and says nothing about rate limits. missing for 10: an explicitly documented availability/search API endpoint, documented rate limits or throttling, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can check domain availability programmatically — a documented check/search API my code or agent can call with clear rate limits

citations.quote: official MCP server documented at https://www.dynadot.com/domain/mcp
The Dynadot API lets you programmatically manage domains, account settings, DNS, orders, and other account activities. Our API supports more than 120 actions
